game_version: Not stated in the paper; the released code uses MineRL 1.0 (Minecraft 1.16.5)

method.summary: A model pretrained on 70,000 hours of unlabeled Minecraft video (actions inferred by an inverse dynamics model), then fine-tuned with reinforcement learning toward a diamond pickaxe. With RL it makes an iron pickaxe in over 80% of 10-minute episodes, collects diamonds in almost 20% and crafts a diamond pickaxe in 2.5%.
method.interface: Screen pixels → keyboard and mouse at 20 Hz
method.interface_zh: 屏幕像素 → 键盘鼠标（20 Hz）
models: VPT foundation model (~0.5B parameters) with RL fine-tuning
method.observation: Raw pixels with the HUD, 128x128 (rendered at 640x360)
method.action: Full keyboard and mouse at 20 Hz, crafting through the normal crafting GUI
method.restarts: Fresh survival world each episode; on death the agent drops its items and respawns, and the episode continues

notes: The paper reports rates over many 10-minute episodes; the milestones are those of its best episodes, where diamonds were collected (iron pickaxe, smelted iron and stone tools are required to mine diamonds). Each episode lasts 10 minutes, so 0:10:00 is an upper bound. Difficulty and seed are not stated. No full-episode video has been checked.
